title: Review of and Actions Taken Following Study on Teachers' Mental Health
what_it_is: Review of and Actions Taken Following Study on Teachers' Mental Health

sections.label: Teacher counselling and well-being
sections.summary: MOE says it lacks figures on teachers seeking in-house counselling and cites regular school visits and surveys to support teacher well-being.

sentences.speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang (Nee Soon)
sentences.text: And second, whether we are seeing an increasing or decreasing trend in terms of number of teachers that are seeking help from our in-house counselling?

sentences.speaker: Dr Mohamad Maliki Bin Osman
sentences.text: We have looked at the report, but the report was conducted post-COVID-19; it was in 2021.

sentences.speaker: Dr Mohamad Maliki Bin Osman
sentences.text: So, we think that situation may vary, may be different today.

sentences.speaker: Dr Mohamad Maliki Bin Osman
sentences.text: I do not have the details or the figures of those who have sought help, but I want to assure Mr Ng that the well-being of our teachers is paramount to MOE.

sentences.speaker: Dr Mohamad Maliki Bin Osman
sentences.text: As mentioned, we do dipstick surveys, we visit schools on a very regular basis.

sentences.speaker: Dr Mohamad Maliki Bin Osman
sentences.text: The political officeholders – Minister Chan Chun Sing, Minister of State Gan Siow Huang and myself – we are visiting schools almost on a weekly basis.

sentences.speaker: Dr Mohamad Maliki Bin Osman
sentences.text: Our senior management visits schools and meet our teachers on a very regular basis, engage them, understand their concerns, respond, should there be immediate needs and create an infrastructure and an ecosystem that is supportive for our teachers.
